description: Fractional-power number encoder compiled to the neural ISA: the bytes of a decimal numeral (optional leading '-', at positions 0..len of an 8-byte input) to the phasor number(n) = exp(i n theta). Each digit byte selects row 10 q + v (q = digits after it) of core.reasoner.number_digits (number(v 10^q)); the rows are bound, and a leading '-' conjugates. No trigonometry runs. dim equals model/specs/reasoning.json.
